name: security-audit
description: Security Audit: weekly security audit of the Mac, SSH keys, repos, GitHub orgs, servers and Claude plugins, with safe automatic fixes and numbered, guided fix groups.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Weekly audit and Wednesday re-check: passphraseless SSH keys, committed secrets, malicious and vulnerable dependencies, GitHub org and Actions risks, server hardening and intrusion signs, and Claude plugin/hook/MCP/permission risks. Safe GitHub fixes and pin-actions pull requests run automatically; everything else is a numbered fix group with its repos, servers, production impact and a guided fix with connectivity checks.
